sentences.text: Shri Ashok Agrawal, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Shri A. Sapre, learned counsel for the intervenor.

Learned counsel for the petitioner at the very outset submits that he does not want to press the petition as contained in relief clause No.11 (1) (b) (c) and (d), he only wants to prosecute this writ petition as far as relief clause No. 11(1)(a) is concerned.

In view of above the objection raised by intervenor represented by Shri A. Sapre, Advocate for the present renders infructuous, as they pertains primarily to relief clause No.11(1)(d).
 Petition is admitted.
 I.A. No.12728/16 for amendment is allowed.
Amendment be incorporated within three days.

Issue notice to respondent Nos.,1 and 2 only with regard to prayer clause no.11(1)(a) which reads as under:
(A) Government of India through Food Safety and Standards Authority of India to immediately laid down the standards for alcoholic beverages as defined in the definition of food under the Act.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: With regard to remaining prayer clause the petition stands dismissed as not pressed.

(RAJENDRA MENON) (ANURAG SHRIVASTAVA)
 ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE JUDGE  ss Rajesh @ Raja Nagdeo vs Union Of India on 16 November, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88914436/
